{{Quote| About five hundred years ago the humans on Rocantor were infected by a plague that jumped the species barrier from the Rocanar—the planet's original sentient inhabitants. There was massive loss of life. When the last of the funeral pyres stopped burning, the surviving Rocantor humans took over. Banned all sentient nonhumans from the planet.|Padmé Amidala|<ref name="CWGS">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref>}}
The '''Rocanar''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rocantor]]. When [[Human/Legends|Human]] colonists arrived on the world around [[500 BBY/Legends|500 BBY]], they fell victim to a [[Unidentified Rocantor plague|plague]] that was originally carried by the Rocanar. After the disease ran its course, killing scores of sentients, the Human Rocantori took control of the planet and banned all [[Alien/Legends|non-Humans]] from living there. The surviving Rocanar were sold into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] off world.<ref name="CWGS" />
